prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) and adding a pet controls quickstart screen (finish, new_screen) were helpful and won, though evidence remains thin with only 1 test each.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change categories, as each has only a single test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all non-winning tests.
Both winning tests (sign_in, reorder and finish, new_screen) were significantly underpredicted.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Add Pet Interaction Sound Check Screen: Adds a final audio and voice test screen right before completion so users can verify pet audio and interaction controls. (why: Support emails show confusion around pet controls (3 emails) and desktop audio/feature behavior (4 emails). Testing audio responsiveness upfront confirms setup.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Photo Upload with Split Layout and Sample Gallery: Redesigns photo upload into a split layout presenting live photo upload alongside sample visual references. (why: Adoption stage has the highest drop-off (60.9% conversion, median 89s) and 3 emails reported custom pet creation failures.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Add Pet Naming and Voice Audio Flow: Inserts a pet naming and voice audition screen between pick friend and photo upload. (why: Adoption has the biggest friction (60.9% conversion). Giving users immediate ownership over pet name and sound preview builds investment before asset generation.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In After Adoption Certificate Step: Moves sign-in screen to take place after adoption certificate creation right before waiting background pet generation. (why: Moving sign-in was a winning strategy in prior tests. Placing sign-in right after certificate adoption leverages emotional momentum.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Sound Notification on Waiting Screen: Enables sound notifications and completion readiness audio when pet creation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait time is very long (mean 2336s) and 3 emails report pets not showing on desktop because users leave during processing.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Clarify Account Sync and Pet Protection Headline: Updates headline and body copy on sign-in screen to emphasize automatic pet backup and account synchronization. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Finalization Tip Banner: Adds a helpful hint banner explaining certificate finalization on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (60.9%). Providing immediate visual guidance speeds up completion.)
